Walking Ballista as an infinite-mana outlet (held in hand; not fetched to battlefield by GSZ/Finale). Oct 27: Star Trek Sagas (Year of Hell, The Wrath of Khan, In the Pale Moonlight, The City on the Edge of Forever, All Good Things..., Those Old Scientists).
